framework: vanilla HTML + Tailwind Play CDN (CDN dropped in the redesign)
font_stack: Plus Jakarta Sans (display) + Inter (body) + Material Symbols (icons)
palette: two conflicting sets: Tailwind config emerald/indigo/amber hexes, and a later :root brand block (paper #f5f3ed, ink #17211f, green #147a59, lime #d8f26a, coral #f28b65)
motion: no library — hand-rolled keyframes + IntersectionObserver reveal on every section (motion-on)
conflict: Tailwind palette vs :root brand block; Material Symbols icons vs typographic voice; hover-scale-everything motion
replaced: type stack (Inter + Plus Jakarta Sans -> Fraunces + IBM Plex Sans + JetBrains Mono)
verdict: Tailwind CDN layer and the ~400 lines of !important overrides were not carried over; the redesign is hand-written CSS driven by tokens.css
logo_reference: user-supplied logotype: #000000 ground, #ffffff ink, #00A0E0 cyan; wide chamfered caps
re_theme: v2 palette + display face derived from the logotype; v1 warm-paper values preserved as a comment block at the foot of tokens.css
